notes.title: Ray Tracing Support
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I'm working on the next Update for the game, since the begining it was planned to include ray traced features but the was not enough time to implement It. So for the next update the game will include ray traced features such as ray traced shadows.

For people how is introducing in this technology, ray tracing is an algorith that calculates very precise the behaviour of the light in the real life, so we achive more realistic shadows, reflections and other effects.

The run this option you must have a graphics card with ray tracing support such as RTX 20, 30 or 40 graphics card series, in amd an RX 6600 or better, RX 7000.
